title: Storage-safe native workflow, preservation and integration convergence

statements.text: Reuse the approved lifecycle, distribution and OpenCode contexts in dotfiles-ai for lifecycle/storage/CI evidence/telemetry, portable policy/deployment and native session/guidance/tool contracts respectively.
CI consumers retain repository-owned implementations/refactors; public contracts must identify no private adopter repository, name, content, branch, path, configuration or results.

Complete whole Discovery before Build; retain primary ownership of integration, readiness and gates, with fresh receipt, exact preflight and plan-specific approval before each source-cycle registration.

Reuse existing contexts and conditional new-cycle authority without relabeling historical delivery, rewriting active approvals/failures or reviving unfinished relocation; keep host evidence private and source facts distinct from runtime qualification.

Allocate new native Worktrunk checkouts below one configurable parent using repository name plus native three-character hash and sanitized branch; collisions or ambiguous membership must refuse without overwrite, suffixing or custom allocator.

Resolve portable home defaults, trusted global and exact-repository TOML overrides into one private workflow-policy JSON and native Worktrunk template; bind external UUID/mountpoint identity and refuse missing/replaced/unsupported roots without fallback.
Do not relocate existing active checkouts; retain their paths and work through completion and preservation.

Prioritize P1 storage prevention, post-merge preservation cleanup and report-only reconciliation; deliver CI/review/feedback/guidance/evaluation as independently bounded slices under the manifest dependency DAG.

Share only immutable DVC cache objects in a repository namespace outside checkouts, keyed by full SHA-256 of canonical Git common directory; keep mutable state/config/locks independent and preserve existing results/unique objects.

Start code-only and hydrate explicit DVC target closure only on a qualified same-filesystem reflink path; unsupported links or effective configuration refuse, never full pull or silent copy/hardlink/symlink fallback.

Trusted exact-repository standing consent authorizes targeted DVC pushes within unchanged approved declaration bytes, targets and destination without repetitive prompts; bind each resolved object manifest and require renewed approval for scope/destination changes.

Permit immediate authorized native cleanup only after fresh ultimate-default merge, independent applicable data preservation, every artifact disposition and no consumers; remove the age hold only for eligible cycles and retain unqualified DVC directories with remote_directory_closure_unverified.
Retain and report or reconcile unknown, dirty, active, busy, unmerged, unpreserved and unsupported states; uncertainty never grants removal or completion.
Never bulk auto-add/commit unknown files, garbage-collect shared caches or use blind ignored-data copying/migration to establish preservation.
Initial all-repository reconciliation is bounded report-only metadata inventory; any legacy remediation batch needs fresh per-artifact disposition and separately approved exact scope.
Virtual-environment deletion is optional separately authorized emergency action, not the main storage plan or permission to discard ignored evidence.

Stale evidence and concurrent consumers can destroy work; require fresh hook checks inside the existing parent supervisor's cooperative removal reservation, reject unavailable descriptor/process capability, and never claim hook-lock transfer or OS-wide atomic exclusion.

Move only the current live conversation through native session_move after safe primary synchronization and before former-checkout removal, preserving identity/history/attachments/compaction; missing required native route retains and idle completed checkouts need no manufactured session.

Identify the unique clean compatible primary, freshly fetch approved default and fast-forward only before live handoff; dirty/diverged/conflicting state remains untouched for RCA and consequential intent reconciliation, never reset or checkout swap.

New Discovery/Build writes use explicit code-only native task checkouts from fresh approved default with valid registration/upstream; preserve unmerged Discovery authority and use one separate Build checkout for existing import when HEAD-equals-base registration requires it.

Reuse an eligible clean checkout across Discovery/Build when registration and writer constraints hold; never duplicate environments/data merely for phase names or bypass bootstrap by resetting authority, premature docs push or actor fabrication.

Use configured short-lived task/context/cycle branches and optional integration/outcome branches; track delivery target separately from ultimate default and retain refs until final integration plus data/artifact preservation.

Report completed_unmerged work for later bounded delegated reconciliation, not automatic abandonment; guard separate local branch deletion by exact-tip CAS and remote deletion by eligible already-configured native after-merge policy only.

Provide intent-driven dbsctr-pr-review using existing functionality/caller inspection first, minimal sufficient solution and proper shared-library authority; reuse delivery mechanisms rather than a second workflow engine.
Centralize/modularize only where appropriate; create no new repository-root directories without explicit agreement.

Automate only uniquely intent-preserving mechanical repairs with affected validation; material semantic/scope/acceptance conflicts pause for RCA and agreement on outcomes/non-goals/semantics/examples, not invented 95-percent numeric confidence.

Bind one user checkpoint to an ordered batch of 1–32 exact PRs in one repository/target unless trusted automatic policy covers it; revalidate each resulting base and renew authorization for material plan/head/order/external-base changes.
Review, integration and prompt simplification preserve exact gates and plan-specific approval; a configuration digest, shell grant or general continuation is not consent for a changed material plan.
Automatic PR merge is default-off exact-repository opt-in, with ordinary mode the default; generated trusted delivery policy is the sole active local authority.

Exact operator-owned repository admin mode is standing consent for eligible native administrator PR merges without repeated mode approval; it never waives affected failures, mandatory safeguards or unavailable native authorization.
Integrator/teammate authority is limited to exact approved feature/integration refs and never ultimate-default promotion by implication.
Native GitHub/user authentication and permissions remain authority; configuration, hashes, environment and role labels grant no credentials or authenticated actor identity.
Integrate through exact-head/base-guarded merge-commit PR merges with verified returned ancestry, never direct protected/default pushes, force pushes, reset or history rewriting.

Derive affected checks from trusted-base repository-owned component/reverse-dependency closure and reviewed workflow/producer identities, not filenames alone or branch self-exemption; unknown scope requires conservative broad checks or blocks.

Bound native exact-head/base evidence watches to 30-second polling and 30 minutes per invocation; report pending/blocked at limits and preserve primary gate authority without daemon, stale replay or identity fabrication.

Only success passes required affected checks; unrelated pending is permitted only with trusted explicit classification and exact repository opt-in, while unknown/missing/skipped or untrusted evidence blocks.

Rerun affected authority after at most three mechanical repairs per persistent problem fingerprint; genuine failure waivers require explicit exact scoped expiring user approval and retain failed evidence, while mandatory security/data-loss/auth checks never waive.
Coordinate CI contracts with existing consumer-owned refactors without taking over their implementations or publishing private consumer facts.
Impose no universal runner or whole-repository validation at every gate; retain every applicable repository-selected authority and broad checks when dependency uncertainty requires them.

Use normalized existing typed switches and versioned source/config/feature snapshots for compatible optional flag-off rollback and regression attribution; never add a second flag file/service or disable safety to claim success.

Keep sanitized feedback local by default in a 256-record, 16-KiB-per-record, 4-MiB, 30-day bounded queue; exact-repository standing destination/scope consent permits deduplicated native GitHub flushes within 30 seconds/three attempts without per-issue repeat prompts.

Native Incident mutation remains typed unavailable until independently qualified; local feedback/external issues must never fabricate Incident/fork IDs or use raw transcript/database transport and borrowed actor identity.

Reconcile review/incident/autonomous-improvement backlog/telemetry availability through qualified sanitized projections before gap prioritization; never create/read PM Kernel tickets or equate unavailable sources with empty/zero.

Reference canonical installed Caveman communication and Ponytail minimal engineering once through managed AGENTS; missing skill is explicit unavailable, not copied full-prompt substitution or duplicate phase injection.
Prompt changes, tool/delegation budgets and compaction preserve safety, gates, privacy, retained evidence and approvals; reread Git authority after compaction and never transform opaque native state.

Apply only source-backed minimal current provider-reference deltas for GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and Opus 5.5; preserve provider affinity and distinguish public model guidance from configured runtime capability or transferable hypotheses.

Keep capability, attribution, tools and delegated/compaction budgets truthful; unavailable usage/cache/billing remains unavailable and no bytes-derived cost, unsupported timing or causal benefit is claimed.

Phase source delivery by actual dependencies and observed gaps rather than implementing every historical idea; keep source-only draft PRs distinct from separately approved host activation and fresh legacy-remediation batches.

Bind RTK compatibility/active route/bypass claims to exact authorized source/runtime evidence, reporting unavailable capability honestly; staged offline public/synthetic replay must not assume installed integration or benefit.

Keep trim1 and filter activation default off; evaluate baseline against one available authorized filter at a time, with no mandatory factorial or default stacking and no activation implied by fixture success.

Retain unfiltered/raw evidence and permission-respecting recovery; exclude lifecycle/approval/gate authority and opaque native state from lossy filtering, and require full expected-fact recall, unchanged gate outcomes and zero synthetic secret leaks on complete fixed-fixture replays.
Offline compression research authorizes no installs, proxy/data routing, paid model/API requests, automatic activation or denied-route workaround.
Change instruction policy to permit the primary's ordinary single-PR native GitHub merge after actual applicable gates and CI succeed, without requiring a human GUI action.

Require exact explicit user authorization or separately qualified exact-repository policy, authenticated fresh native evidence, exact-head guard and enforceable strict current-base protection; no admin bypass or failed required gate waiver.

Inspect actual DBSCTR cycle gate evidence and ancestry when applicable; dependency-only or other policy exemptions require explicit documented scope justification rather than fabricated cycle evidence.
Add no merge engine or autonomous CLI qualification: check pr-review remains structurally blocked and supplied JSON never authenticates CI or grants merge authority.
Verify remote outcome, ordered merge parents and head/gate ancestry before reporting merged; reconcile uncertainty before retry and retain branches/worktrees without deletion.

Deliver minimal instruction-only source changes; source Release/Deploy/Operate are not applicable with profile-bound reasons, while newly merged skill activation is explicit later work, never a circular pre-merge gate or implied current activation.

Reuse lifecycle context and delivered integration-review/ci-contracts dependencies; Discovery owns normative scope and Build requires fresh readiness validation, receipt, exact preflight and explicit digest-bound approval before registration.

Approved amendment to INT-054/057 for this route supersedes immutable-base consent and approved-base parent assertions: authorization binds exact repository, PR head, target branch and ordinary merge consequence. Record timed observed-base evidence, revalidate base advances and fresh CI under unchanged scope/protections without renewed consent solely for base advance; changed head, target, material intent or protections requires renewed approval. Strict native current-base protection must enforce successful applicable checks covering the actual merged base/result. Verify second parent equals approved head and first parent is actual merged base; reconcile uncertainty before retry, never equate stale tested base with actual base or claim atomic base CAS.

Extend existing workflow-convergence context map in dotfiles-ai: lifecycle owns administrative state, preservation and reachability; OpenCode owns supported native user journey; distribution owns installed qualification and one nominated recovery. Deliver logical closure before physical cleanup.

Support record-only retirement for supported branch-bound legacy, adopted and native cycles, including local-only records, without adoption, successful gates or checkout deletion as prerequisites; retain failed evidence and reconcile only exact active pointers with crash-safe retries.

Support superseded with optional successor, cancelled without successor, and empty only with no-work proof; administrative disposition never falsifies completed validation or uncertain external effects.

Use exact preview and fresh locked recheck with interactive terminal or exact chat approval recorded as agent-confirmed consent assertion; preserve independent native permission and unavailable actor-attribution boundaries.

Amend completed/merged-only manual removal for explicitly approved superseded/cancelled work: verified durable local refs covering original/import/current commits and private recovery evidence may replace integration proof, without remote publication or disk-loss protection; no implicit archive expiry or ref disposal.

Provide exact inventory and explicitly approved capture/verify/restore of supported dirty and ignored regular files, preserving staged/unstaged distinctions and private evidence; unknown/changing/special files and unqualified DVC obligations retain checkout.

After separate exact approval, archive restore verification and no consumers, permit narrowly restoring archived tracked paths to HEAD and deleting only exact archived ordinary untracked/ignored files to prepare for normal hooked Worktrunk removal; journal interruptions and retain changed/unlisted files.

Operator-confirmed stopped writers permit record closure while idle read-only/MCP consumers remain; known live writes refuse closure and all relevant consumers still block physical preparation/removal. Session move alone never proves child processes exited.

Qualify an explicitly approved manual removal route through existing supervisor, reservation, checker and Worktrunk hooks independently of unavailable automatic policy/identity producers; keep fresh preservation/process/native permission checks and truthful cooperative-lock limits.

Every supported registration mode must have executable successful and non-successful public-CLI exits, interrupted retry, historical reading and archive recovery tests; migration cannot retire the last supported exit while leaving registration enabled.

Deliver supported OpenCode guidance for preview/approval/status/retry and native same-conversation handoff; any consumer shutdown/restart requires separate approval and qualified native operation, never ad hoc kill or manufactured session.

Include targeted compatible installed-tool qualification and one operator-nominated live stuck-cycle recovery after merged source and fresh exact approvals; preserve compatible readers, preimages, archives and failed evidence on rollback, and distinguish closure success from blocked physical cleanup.

Do not enable automatic cleanup, bulk retirement, remote publication, branch/archive deletion, shared-cache GC, raw Git worktree deletion, force/hook bypass, arbitrary record editing, reset or a second lifecycle/identity engine as this repair.

Updated CLI writers share locks; held locks or positively identified live writers refuse closure. Unfinished historical intervals alone remain uncertain, optional/missing history never proves inactivity, and explicit operator quiescence assertion is required. No new liveness/identity service.

Old writers stopped and incompatible clients kept out is an operational prerequisite to closure, not universal fencing. Updated clients enforce terminal records; distribution qualifies compatible tools and retained rollback reader. Consumer/removal safeguards and separate destructive approval remain unchanged.

Replay retains original approved digest and verified original-byte preimage/hash/custody; intent and current terminal record must match original plus exact approved metadata except pointer_status reconciliation. Drift blocks different effects under stale consent; only pointer_status advances. Initial conflicting pointer refuses; post-terminal reassignment is retained, recovery_required and blocks registration. Prepared-only evidence stays in private sidecar outside active record; new retirement metadata is terminal only. Genuine completed history/counts remain; administrative retirement creates no success.

Provide a narrow digest-bound initiative-amend operation for existing ACTIVE native-owned schema 3/4/5/6 cycles with Initiative receipts, same repository/context/slice and unchanged profile/risk/applicability/delivery; fresh committed dependency-satisfied Build receipt and exact state-bound approval required. No Git mutation or automatic document import; ordinary begin/resume remains exact-match only.

Preserve original registration/import/receipt/approval/IDs/baseline/commits/failures; append the exact version-1 effective-authority entry with exclusive durable immediate-pre-amendment preimage, hash-bound owned private approved-plan envelope and separate deterministic replacement outcome under existing locks, without recursive hashes. Readers validate the full chain; exact approved replay with verified preimage/postimage is already_applied without duplicate entries or repeated gate reopening; stale or malformed state blocks. Bounded result statuses/exits and sanitized summaries follow the feature contract, never raw private envelope output.

Material authority amendment reopens all required gates to pending and removes current evidence and exception fields, preserving ledger/failures/exception history in preimage/history. Preimage ledger IDs cannot dispose reopened gates; newly executed evidence is required even at unchanged HEAD and enforced through gate/commit/completion/final-push checks. Completion requires one recorded ordinary Gate Commit establishing the full selected path/blob/mode closure and effective closure validation at HEAD, without replacing discovery_import or weakening evidence path-set checks; material drift requires fresh Discovery/amendment, editorial remediation explicit existing scope authority and exact validation. Bind unrelated dirt without touching it; retain local-only no-network, final-push lineage, unchanged critical Python/Security CORE-SOURCE plan and exact consent without fabricated actor attribution.

This distinct prerequisite source repair is not replacement or erasure of the blocked original retirement cycle, a self-amending bootstrap, a second engine, helper configuration repair, installation or live amendment. Separate approved merged installation and exact real-cycle amendment, plus independent permission repair, are later prerequisites; preserve all historical evidence and operational compatibility limits.

Support ordinary staged and unstaged tracked deletions through evidence, Gate Commit, readers and completion with explicit tracked-absence semantics, including rename delete/add; reject never-tracked, unsafe and secret paths. Representation and compatible authority/recovery choices remain open Discovery, separate from the ready authority-amendment repair.

Support explicit review and recording of ordinary same-repository branch integration with exact incoming commit closure, resulting tree and gates, distinguishing cycle-owned from imported commits. Preserve approved-default reconciliation, pre-cycle safeguards, failures and DVC/remote consent; no arbitrary ahead commits, patch-equivalence inference, unvalidated passed merge, history rewrite or live auto-closure. Authority/import interface and already-recorded-merge recovery remain unresolved Discovery.
